content.short: AesirX Business Suite is the forefront of the digital privacy revolution, changing how data is owned, controlled, and used.
content.description: AesirX's flagship product, the Shield of Privacy, is a next-generation solution that gives individuals true ownership and control over their personal data. It keeps your information under your control and, when appropriate, where you choose to store it. Our granular consent model lets you decide who can access your data, for what purposes, and for how long, with clear, actionable controls. Manage permissions via a simple interface and apply changes with a single click, balancing privacy with usability.
